story: The Anamnesis: Alistair Vance, Evelyn, and the Meaning of Time

time_as_a_concept: time did not flow so much as it pooled
Time was no longer a cage or a river carrying him away
it was a song they were all singing together
clocks_and_mechanisms: the ticking of the repaired machine
its pendulum tracing its infinite loops
a soft, clear, and perfectly steady resonance
relationship_with_time: the rhythm of Alistair’s world was disrupted
the workshop lost its collective heartbeat
he forgot to wind his own grandfather clocks
their deep, familiar voices returning to the room

memories_and_past: a language that predated the valley
the clockmaker had discovered in the desert
fading like a dream upon waking
emotional_resonance: tuning into the residual emotional energy
left behind by the operator’s life
sorrow balancing a bright strand of joy
memory_and_identity: not to be cured of my past
the machine could be made whole
the unique, beautiful architecture of the soul

sorrow_and_pain: the scratching of his own breath
not to be cured of my past
joy_and_happiness: golden light of the setting sun
balance_of_emotions: sorrow balancing a bright strand of joy
whether born of fear or courage
